items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Yakutat.

* WHEN...Until midnight AKST tonight.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 10 at 6:23PM AKST until November 11 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Patchy blowing snow. Total snow accumulations
up to 5 inches near White Pass. Winds gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Klondike Highway past milepost 10.

* WHEN...From midnight tonight to 3 PM AKST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult to impossible.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions where available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.
